changelog: SmashyStream is gone — it never showed a picture on the Firestick, only a black screen. The source list is down to three: VidSrc, VidLink, then PrimeWire. PrimeWire is new and sits last; it does not start on its own, so pick its Filemoon server from the Source button and it plays. The VidSrc mirror was dropped too — it ran on the same servers as VidSrc, so when one was down both were.
